newsitem.title: USA: Newell posts record Q1 net as margins rise.
newsitem.headline: Newell posts record Q1 net as margins rise.

text.p: Newell Co said Tuesday higher profitability at its picture frame unit and higher margins at its core businesses sent earnings to record levels in the first quarter ended March 31.

The consumer products manufacturing company reported net income of $37.8 million, or $0.24 a share, compared with $33.2 million, or $0.21, a year ago. Sales improved to $629.4 million from $618.2 million last year, Newell said.
The company said the higher sales and earnings were the result of the January 1996 acquisition of Holson Burnes, the March 1997 purchase of Rolodex and internal growth.
Newell shares were up 1/2 Tuesday at 35-1/8.
